Jordan / Kim — digging into this. When a GCal invite is forwarded externally via some clients, HTML anchors in the description are often stripped due to our customers' MTA / proxy policies (OliveBank's gateway in this case). The underlying meetLink (href) still exists in the ics payload usually, but some clients drop it on render.

Workarounds:
1) Regenerate an ics that sets the location field to a short, numeric Zoom URL (clients tend to surface that).
2) Send a plain-text email with the numeric Zoom URL and provide a host claim token (we'll act as the host to avoid resign-on-organizer problems).
3) Provide a Google Meet alternative if SSO is a hard requirement (but Meet can require organizer affinity and cause RSVP issues if we change the organizer).

I'll create a temporary bridge token and pre-authorize a host claim under my account. If we go Zoom fallback, I can be the temporary host and then hand off recording rights after the meeting.

Attachment: meeting-bridge-token.txt (text/plain)

—Ben
